title: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level

result.label: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level
result.statement: Proves the unramified de Rham quantum geometric Langlands equivalence for every connected simple complex algebraic group on every smooth projective connected complex curve, at every shifted level c C Q. It identifies the full derived categories of twisted D -modules for the group and its Langlands dual, retaining all global forms and connected components.
